question: Who is the author of the book ‘Pride, Prejudice, and Punditry’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Shashi Tharoor​.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Former union minister and Lok Sabha MP Dr. Shashi Tharoor's 23rd book, 'Pride, Prejudice and Punditry, was launched in Hyderabad.
 
• The book marks the culmination of over 50 years of Dr. Tharoor’s writings. 
 
• The book is published by Aleph Book Company.
